name: Satyr
overview: The Bible references satyrs as mythological creatures, described as half-man and half-goat, appearing in desolate and cursed places as depicted in Isaiah 13:21 and 34:14. These passages portray satyrs dwelling among wild beasts and other ominous creatures, symbolizing the desolation and judgment upon the land. The Old Testament also condemns the worship of such entities, equating them with devils or demons, as seen in Leviticus 17:7 and 2 Chronicles 11:15, highlighting the call to reject idolatry and false sacrifices in favor of true worship of God.
